[
  {
    "dataset_name": "2dplanes",
    "model_family": "linear_svm",
    "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
    "schema_version": "1.0",
    "features": [
      {
        "name": "x1_squared",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "Squared value of x1, capturing non-linear magnitude effects.",
        "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "non_linear_transformation",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear SVM to model parabolic or symmetric relationships along the x1 axis.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "x1 ** 2"
      },
      {
        "name": "x2_squared",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "Squared value of x2, capturing non-linear magnitude effects.",
        "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "non_linear_transformation",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear SVM to model parabolic or symmetric relationships along the x2 axis.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "x2 ** 2"
      },
      {
        "name": "x1_x2_cross",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "Product of x1 and x2, representing their interaction.",
        "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "interaction",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct interaction term, enabling the linear model to capture diagonal decision boundaries.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "x1 * x2"
      },
      {
        "name": "x1_x2_sum",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "Sum of x1 and x2, representing a 45-degree linear projection.",
        "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
        "feature_family": "linear_projection",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a new orthogonal basis feature that can simplify the margin optimization for the SVM.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "x1 + x2"
      },
      {
        "name": "x1_x2_diff",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "Difference between x1 and x2, representing a 135-degree linear projection.",
        "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
        "feature_family": "linear_projection",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a complementary orthogonal basis feature to the sum, aiding in margin separation.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "x1 - x2"
      },
      {
        "name": "euclidean_norm",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "The L2 norm (Euclidean distance from the origin) across all 10 dimensions.",
        "value_range": [0.0, 3.163],
        "feature_family": "distance_metric",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of the point's distance from the center, useful for radial margin effects.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "np.sqrt(x1**2 + x2**2 + x3**2 + x4**2 + x5**2 + x6**2 + x7**2 + x8**2 + x9**2 + x10**2)"
      },
      {
        "name": "l1_norm_avg",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "The average L1 norm (Manhattan distance) across all 10 dimensions.",
        "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "distance_metric",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Offers a robust, smooth normalized score of overall feature magnitude, less sensitive to single extreme values than L2 norm.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "(np.abs(x1) + np.abs(x2) + np.abs(x3) + np.abs(x4) + np.abs(x5) + np.abs(x6) + np.abs(x7) + np.abs(x8) + np.abs(x9) + np.abs(x10)) / 10.0"
      },
      {
        "name": "max_x1_to_x4",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "The maximum value among the first four features (x1 to x4).",
        "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "bounding_statistic",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the most extreme positive deviation in the primary feature subset, providing a bounding feature for the SVM.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(x1, x2), x3), x4)"
      },
      {
        "name": "min_x1_to_x4",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "The minimum value among the first four features (x1 to x4).",
        "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "bounding_statistic",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the most extreme negative deviation in the primary feature subset, providing a lower bounding feature.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(x1, x2), x3), x4)"
      },
      {
        "name": "x1_x2_pseudo_angle",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "A categorical-like numeric assignment based on the quadrant of the (x1, x2) plane.",
        "value_range": [1.0, 4.0],
        "feature_family": "spatial_segmentation",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a step-wise non-linear transformation that can help the linear model segment the space.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "np.where((x1 > 0) & (x2 > 0), 1.0, np.where((x1 < 0) & (x2 > 0), 2.0, np.where((x1 < 0) & (x2 < 0), 3.0, 4.0)))"
      },
      {
        "name": "x3_x4_cross",
        "type": "formula",
        "description": "Product of x3 and x4, representing their interaction.",
        "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "interaction",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an interaction term for the secondary feature pair, enabling the linear model to capture complex dependencies.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true,
        "formula": "x3 * x4"
      },
      {
        "name": "structural_anomaly_score",
        "type": "judgment",
        "description": "Semantic judgment assessing the likelihood that the coordinate combination represents a structural anomaly or outlier in the 10-dimensional space.",
        "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
        "feature_family": "anomaly_detection",
        "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, non-linear assessment of point typicality, which can act as a strong prior or regularizer for the SVM margin.",
        "leakage_risk": "low",
        "uses_only_row_values": true
      }
    ]
  }
]
